# TransactionModal Shadow Spec

> TransactionModal - Redesigned transaction entry bottom sheet aligned with the design system, replacing the current Material3 TabRow/OutlinedTextField layout with design-token-native components

**Status:** In Progress
**Generated by:** spec-lead + @pseudo-worker

## Data Model

```sudolang
// No new domain models. The modal reads/writes the existing:
interface CreateTransactionRequest {
  accountId: Long;
  amount: Long;              // cents
  date: Long;                // Unix ms UTC
  type: TransactionType;     // INCOME | EXPENSE | TRANSFER
  status: TransactionStatus; // PENDING | CONFIRMED (driven by STATUS checkboxes)
  category: String?;         // mapped from the "Name" field; optional when type is TRANSFER
  description: String?;      // not shown in modal — always null from this form
  destinationAccountId: Long?; // required when type is TRANSFER; null otherwise
}

// Modal local UI state (ephemeral, not persisted)
interface TransactionModalLocalState {
  amountInput: String;           // raw decimal string, e.g. "12.50"
  selectedDateMillis: Long;      // UTC start-of-day
  selectedAccountId: Long?;
  categoryInput: String;         // maps to CreateTransactionRequest.category
  statusInput: TransactionStatus; // PENDING | CONFIRMED
  showDatePicker: Boolean;
  showAccountPicker: Boolean;    // opens AccountPickerModal for source account
  destinationAccountId: Long?;
  showDestinationPicker: Boolean; // opens AccountPickerModal for destination account
}
```

---

## Constraints

```sudolang
Constraint: Type selector shows INCOME, EXPENSE, and TRANSFER — when TRANSFER is selected, a destination account field appears.
Constraint: Account and Destination Account fields open a full-screen AccountPickerModal instead of a dropdown menu.
Constraint: AccountPickerModal shows each account as a row with: account name (primary text), formatted balance (CurrencyUtils.formatCents), and account type badge (BcBadge with type-appropriate variant).
Constraint: Account type badge variant mapping: CHECKING → Info, SAVINGS → Success, CREDIT_CARD → Warning, CASH → Pending, INVESTMENT → Info.
Constraint: AccountPickerModal has a back arrow (BcHeader) to dismiss without changing selection. Tapping an account row applies the selection and closes the modal.
Constraint: Destination account picker filters out the source account. Category is optional when type is TRANSFER.
Constraint: AccountPickerModal is shared between TransactionFormSheet and AddSandboxTransactionSheet — lives in core/designsystem/component/.
Constraint: "Name" field maps to category in CreateTransactionRequest — not a separate field
Constraint: Status checkboxes are mutually exclusive (radio-like): selecting one deselects the other
Constraint: Scheduled (Future) → TransactionStatus.PENDING; Paid / Cleared → TransactionStatus.CONFIRMED
Constraint: Amount field must use LargeAmountInput (node L2zpZ) — not OutlinedTextField
Constraint: Name / Date / Account fields must use BcInputGroup (node c9XFF)
Constraint: Status options must use BcCheckboxRow (node 4SRSD)
Constraint: CTA is a single full-width BcButton(variant = Primary) — no separate Cancel button
Constraint: X close button in header replaces Cancel — calls onCancel callback
Constraint: Date and Account fields render side-by-side in a Row with Modifier.weight(1f) each
Constraint: Description field is not shown — always passed as null to CreateTransactionRequest
Constraint: Modal opens fully expanded to full screen height — skipPartiallyExpanded = true on SheetState; no partial/half-expanded state
Constraint: Drag handle is hidden — dragHandle = {} on ModalBottomSheet
Constraint: CTA button is sticky at the bottom — lives outside the scrollable Column; only the form fields scroll
Constraint: All color, spacing, radius, and typography values use BcColors / BcSpacing / BcRadius / BcTypography tokens — no raw values
Constraint: Validation logic is unchanged: amount > 0, accountId required, category required (unless type is TRANSFER)
Constraint: Insufficient funds warning is preserved for EXPENSE type when amount > account balance
```

## Data Flow

```sudolang
// Open Modal Flow
User taps + (FAB) |> TransactionFormSheet(isVisible = true)
  |> LaunchedEffect sets selectedType to EXPENSE (default)
  |> LaunchedEffect auto-selects first account if none selected
  |> Render header (title + X), BcSegmentedControl, LargeAmountInput,
     BcInputGroup (Name), Row(BcInputGroup Date, BcInputGroup Account),
     BcInputGroup (Destination Account, visible when TRANSFER),
     STATUS section (2x BcCheckboxRow), BcButton CTA

// User changes type
User taps segment |> onSetType(TransactionType.INCOME | EXPENSE | TRANSFER)
  |> uiState.selectedType updates
  |> BcSegmentedControl re-renders active segment
  |> CTA label updates: "Add Income" | "Add Expense" | "Add Transfer"

// User selects account
User taps Account field |> showAccountPicker = true
  |> AccountPickerModal opens with full-screen ModalBottomSheet
  |> Displays list of accounts: name + balance + type badge per row
  |> User taps account row |> selectedAccountId = account.id; showAccountPicker = false
  |> OR User taps back arrow |> showAccountPicker = false (no change)

// User selects destination account (TRANSFER only)
User taps Destination Account field |> showDestinationPicker = true
  |> AccountPickerModal opens with filtered list (excludes source account)
  |> User taps account row |> destinationAccountId = account.id; showDestinationPicker = false

// User selects status
User taps checkbox row |> statusInput = PENDING | CONFIRMED
  |> Both BcCheckboxRow instances re-render (one checked, one unchecked)

// Save flow
User taps CTA |> validate(amountInput, selectedAccountId, categoryInput)
  |> If errors: populate localErrors, return early
  |> onSave(CreateTransactionRequest(
       accountId, amount, date, type = selectedType,
       status = statusInput, category = categoryInput, description = null,
       destinationAccountId = if (selectedType == TRANSFER) destinationAccountId else null))

// Close flow
User taps X |> onCancel()
  |> ModalBottomSheet dismissed
```

## Function Signatures

```sudolang
// New shared component

fn AccountPickerModal(
  isVisible: Boolean,
  accounts: List<Account>,
  selectedAccountId: Long?,
  title: String,                     // "Select Account" or "Select Destination"
  onAccountSelected: (Long) -> Unit,
  onDismiss: () -> Unit,
)
// Renders: ModalBottomSheet(skipPartiallyExpanded = true, dragHandle = {})
//   └── Column(fillMaxHeight)
//       ├── BcHeader(title, actionIcon = Icons.Outlined.ArrowBack, onActionClick = onDismiss)
//       └── LazyColumn
//           └── For each account: AccountPickerRow
//               Row(padding = spacing4, verticalAlignment = CenterVertically)
//                 Column(weight 1f) { Text(account.name, bodyLarge); Text(formatCents(balance), bodySmall, textSecondary) }
//                 BcBadge(account.type.displayName, variant = typeBadgeVariant)
//                 if (account.id == selectedAccountId) Icon(Icons.Outlined.Check, colorSuccess)

// Badge variant mapping for account types
fn accountTypeBadgeVariant(type: AccountType): BadgeVariant {
  CHECKING → Info
  SAVINGS → Success
  CREDIT_CARD → Warning
  CASH → Pending
  INVESTMENT → Info
}

// Existing design system components

fn LargeAmountInput(
  label: String,                   // "AMOUNT" — uppercase, caption style, 2sp letterSpacing
  amount: String,                  // raw decimal input string
  onAmountChange: (String) -> Unit,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
)
// Renders: Column { caption label; BasicTextField(displayLarge typography, ₱0.00 placeholder) }

fn BcInputGroup(
  label: String,
  value: String,
  onValueChange: (String) -> Unit,
  placeholder: String,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
  readOnly: Boolean = false,
  trailingContent: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null,
  isError: Boolean = false,
  errorText: String? = null,
  keyboardOptions: KeyboardOptions = KeyboardOptions.Default,
)
// Renders: Column { caption label; Box with 1.5dp borderStrong border, radius lg (12dp), BasicTextField }

fn BcCheckboxRow(
  label: String,
  checked: Boolean,
  onCheckedChange: (Boolean) -> Unit,
  modifier: Modifier = Modifier,
)
// Renders: Row(gap 12dp) { 24x24dp checkbox box (radius md/8dp, bgDark fill when checked); Text(bodyMedium) }

// Updated composable
fn TransactionFormSheet(
  isVisible: Boolean,
  uiState: TransactionFormUiState,
  initialDateMillis: Long,
  initialData: Transaction? = null,
  onSetType: (TransactionType) -> Unit,
  onSave: (CreateTransactionRequest) -> Unit,
  onCancel: () -> Unit,
  onDelete: ((Transaction) -> Unit)? = null,
)
```

```sudolang
//           ├── BcButton(Primary, fillMaxWidth, "Add Expense" | "Add Income" | "Add Transfer" | "Save")
```

## Edge Cases

| Case | Condition | Handling |
|------|-----------|----------|
| Empty amount | `amountInput` blank or zero | Show inline error "Enter a valid amount"; block save |
| No account | `selectedAccountId` is null | Show inline error "Account is required"; block save |
| Empty name | `categoryInput` is blank and type is INCOME or EXPENSE | Show inline error "Category is required"; block save (not enforced for TRANSFER) |
| Insufficient funds | EXPENSE amount > selected account balance | Show warning banner; allow save (warning only) |
| Edit mode | `initialData != null` | Title becomes "Edit Transaction"; CTA label is "Save"; Delete button appears below CTA |
| Single account | Only one account in `uiState.availableAccounts` | Auto-select; account field is read-only with that account's name; AccountPickerModal still opens but only shows one row |
| No accounts | `uiState.availableAccounts` is empty | Account field shows "No accounts" placeholder; save blocked; AccountPickerModal shows empty state |
| Submitting | `uiState.isSubmitting == true` | CTA shows "Saving…", disabled; X close button disabled |
| Amount placeholder | `amountInput` is empty | Display "₱0.00" in `textTertiary` color via BasicTextField decoration |
| No destination account | `selectedType == TRANSFER` and `destinationAccountId` is null | Show inline error "Destination account is required"; block save |
| Same source and destination | `selectedType == TRANSFER` and `destinationAccountId == selectedAccountId` | Destination picker filters out source account; save blocked if equal |
| Dismiss picker without selection | User taps back arrow in AccountPickerModal | Modal closes; `selectedAccountId` / `destinationAccountId` unchanged |
| Account picker with selected item | `selectedAccountId != null` when picker opens | Selected account row shows a checkmark icon in colorSuccess |
